questions.question: It was not until I had finished my degree that I realized the importance of developing a strong professional network.
options: I had only just finished my degree when it hit me.
It wasn't until after finishing university that I understood.
Not until completing my studies did I appreciate the value of networking.
Only once I'd graduated did I grasp the significance.
questions.answer: Not until completing my studies did I appreciate the value of networking.

questions.question: Had he been more careful, the accident might have been avoided.
options: If only he had taken more care, there wouldn't have been an accident.
He would have avoided the accident if he'd been more cautious.
Being more vigilant could have prevented the accident from happening.
The accident occurred because he wasn't careful enough.
questions.answer: He would have avoided the accident if he'd been more cautious.

questions.question: What I regret most is not having had the opportunity to visit my grandparents while they were still alive.
options: It's what I'm most sorry about, that I never got to see them.
The thing I wish I'd done more was visiting them when they needed me.
I often think about how lucky I am to have such wonderful memories of them.
What I miss the most is not having had a chance to spend time with my grandparents.
questions.answer: It's what I'm most sorry about, that I never got to see them.

questions.question: By the time the project was completed, several key team members had already left the company.
options: Several important staff members had departed by the time we finished the project.
The project was finished just as a few crucial team members were leaving their jobs.
A number of essential personnel had moved on to other positions before the project's completion.
Key team members continued working on the project even after several of them had left.
questions.answer: Several important staff members had departed by the time we finished the project.

questions.question: It is essential that all employees are aware of and adhere to the company's strict confidentiality policy.
options: All workers must be informed about and comply with our confidential information rules.
The company's secrecy policy should be clearly communicated to everyone.
Our employees need to understand and respect the importance of keeping things private.
It is crucial that all staff are made aware of and follow the strict confidentiality guidelines.
questions.answer: All workers must be informed about and comply with our confidential information rules.
